lambda_variant: none: ECS Fargate service through ECS Express Mode

base_image.patch_owner: the team that owns the service: rebuild when the base image digest changes

instrumentation.logging: one JSON line per request on stdout with correlation_id and status; awslogs driver
instrumentation.tracing: none; the load balancer's X-Amzn-Trace-Id is logged, no X-Ray segments
instrumentation.powertools: not used; Powertools is for Lambda

compute.aws_owned: Express Mode creates and deletes the load balancer, listener rules, target groups, security groups, scaling policy, certificate and deployment alarm; Terraform does not manage them
compute.gaps: no WAF, no ALB access logs, no custom listener rules, deployment strategy fixed to canary; a team that needs these needs an explicit Fargate profile

review: pending: promote status to supported after a person reviews the sandbox evidence
